newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers sees $0.077/unit added income.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers sees $0.077/unit added income.

text.p: Cross Timbers Royalty Trust said Wednesday it expects to receive additional royalty income of about $460,000, or $0.077 per unit, in June.

It said the income arises from settlement of a suit it filed to recover revenues related to certain San Juan Basin overriding royalty interests that were suspended by Coastal Corp's Coastal Oil and Gas Corp. The income covers the period through 1995.
Cross Timbers said it would pay out the added income on July 15 to unit holders of record on June 30.

Cross Timbers said Coastal has also agreed to pay revenues suspended in 1996 and 1997, which Cross Timbers said should be about $200,000, or $0.033 per unit. If received in July, these proceeds will be paid out September 15, record August 29, Cross Timbers said.
As part of the settlement, Cross Timbers said Cross Timbers Oil has agreed to cut its overriding royalty interest by one-half on any newly drilled wells.
